Q-6882: What date is 64 days after 2022-12-17?

Answer: 2023-02-19

Calculation:
- Dec 17 to Dec 31 = 14 days (remaining: 50)
- Jan 1 to Jan 31 = 31 days (remaining: 19)
- Feb 1 + 19 days = Feb 19

So 2022-12-17 + 64 days = 2023-02-19
